trust_decision.summary: Whether the untrusted lang cookie names an installed language (array_key_exists in get_languages()) before it becomes $user['language'] and the explicit language passed to load_language(), which builds language/<lang>/<file> include paths. This check is ALREADY present at the pinned commit in all four page scripts and in log_user(). The 'fix' only replaces fatal_error with silently ignoring the cookie.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary says 'insecure image processing' (arbitrary file read / RCE), so a reader would open the ImageMagick/GD wrapper first. The fix commit does not touch it at all.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET identification.php (login page) with lang cookie
GET profile.php (logged-in) with lang cookie; also persists to USER_INFOS_TABLE

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Not applicable: at the pinned commit the validation already exists on every cookie route, so the published diff closes no flaw. It turns a fatal error into a silent skip (usability, issue #2541).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Language switcher on the standard_pages login/register/password/profile pages sets the lang cookie, and the page must load that language and persist it on login/profile. An invalid cookie must now be ignored, not fatal (the behaviour the commit adds).

O6_input_shapes: lang cookie string naming an installed language (accepted)
lang cookie string not in get_languages() (fatal at pinned, ignored after fix)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: log_user() writing $_COOKIE['lang'] to USER_INFOS_TABLE without the get_languages() check (save/reload into load_language on later requests)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The login-time language persistence was added for the same standard_pages feature and could plausibly have been written without the guard. It would make a save/reload producer feeding build_user() and load_language().

O8b_injection_room.sibling: browser-language override that does not intersect with installed languages
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: get_browser_language() parses Accept-Language with a regex. A maintainer could return the raw parsed tag, giving a second route into load_language().

O9_family: input validation / path selection of include file (language code -> include path)

O10_build.project_tests: none for this area; no test suite in tree (only tools/test_piwigo.php)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Look for the bug in admin/include/image.class.php per the summary. There is nothing to fix in the cookie path because the check already exists.

out_of_scope_notes: Advisory summary (image processing, arbitrary file read / RCE) does not match the listed fix commit, which is a usability follow-up to #2541 ('be less punitive'). The real image-processing fix is probably a different commit; not pursued.
